slides.h1: The Dhana Yoga Pattern Behind Self-Made, Not Inherited, Wealth
slides.sub: Not one yoga — a repeating combination that shows up across genuinely different charts.

slides.h2: Inherited vs self-made — different house signature
slides.body: Inherited wealth leans on the 4th and 8th (what comes from family, what comes from others). Self-made wealth leans on the 2nd, 11th, and 10th — earned resources, earned gains, earned effort.

points: 2nd and 11th lords connected — by conjunction, mutual aspect, or exchange
10th lord well-placed and linked into that same connection
A kendra-trikona raja yoga reinforcing the 10th, not just the 2nd/11th
Dignity matters — the connecting planets need real strength, not just a technical link

slides.h2: Why it doesn't fire at birth
slides.body: This yoga exists in the D-1 from day one. It activates in the Mahadasha or Antardasha of one of its own participating lords — which is why the wealth looks sudden from the outside, decades in.

slides.h2: The check that separates real from cancelled
slides.body: A textbook combination can still be yoga-bhanga (cancelled) — a participating lord that's debilitated, combust, or badly placed weakens the whole structure. The combination has to hold up, not just exist on paper.

slides.h2: Look for the scaled-down version in your own chart
slides.body: Free chart read — see if your 2nd/11th/10th are linked, and roughly when it activates.
